dataIdInfo.idPurp: Automated Damage Assessment extracts target features, finds post-event imagery areas that resemble user-provided examples, and measures image-based damage evidence. It supports Feature Extraction, Embedding Similarity, and Damage Assessment workflows using ArcGIS GeoAI tools, SAM3, and supported embedding models.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Choose a Feature Type first. The available Workflow choices then update to match that feature type. Feature Extraction creates target polygons from imagery. Embedding Similarity identifies post-event imagery cells that resemble at least six example points. Damage Assessment compares target features to similar embedding cells and assigns image-evidence classes. Outputs are preliminary analytical results and should be reviewed against source imagery and field observations.

Parameter.Name: Feature Type
Parameter.Description: Select the target object type. This choice sets feature-specific defaults and controls the available workflow choices.

Parameter.Name: Workflow
Parameter.Description: Select Feature Extraction to create target features, Embedding Similarity to find imagery resembling examples, or Damage Assessment to compare target features with post-event similarity results. Available choices depend on Feature Type.

Parameter.Name: Input Target Features (Optional)
Parameter.Description: Optional target polygons for the Damage Assessment workflow. When supplied, feature extraction is skipped and the polygons are used to measure post-event similarity evidence.

Parameter.Name: Area of Interest Polygon (Optional; Clips Supplied Targets and Overrides Extent)
Parameter.Description: Optional analysis boundary. It clips supplied target features and overrides the Extent environment. An AOI or a defined Extent environment is required when imagery must be processed.

Parameter.Name: Feature Extraction Imagery Source
Parameter.Description: Choose Input Imagery to use a raster layer from the active map, or World Imagery Wayback to download a selected historical World Imagery release for feature extraction.

Parameter.Name: Feature Extraction Imagery Layer (from Active Map)
Parameter.Description: Select the active-map raster layer used for SAM3 feature extraction when Feature Extraction Imagery Source is Input Imagery.

Parameter.Name: Feature Extraction World Imagery Wayback Release
Parameter.Description: Select the World Imagery Wayback release used for feature extraction. The list is filtered when local imagery-change metadata is available.

Parameter.Name: Custom Extraction Model (.dlpk, Optional; Default: Living Atlas SAM3)
Parameter.Description: Optional local deep learning package that overrides the default Living Atlas SAM3 model used for target-feature extraction.

Parameter.Name: Custom SAM3 Text Prompt
Parameter.Description: Text prompt supplied to SAM3 when Feature Type is Custom. Describe the object concept to extract.

Parameter.Name: Feature Detection Cell Size
Parameter.Description: Output cell size, in meters, for SAM3 feature extraction. Smaller values can improve detail but increase processing time and GPU memory use.

Parameter.Name: Post-Event Imagery Source
Parameter.Description: Choose Input Imagery, Current World Imagery, or World Imagery Wayback as the imagery source used to generate post-event embeddings.

Parameter.Name: Post-Event Imagery Layer (from Active Map)
Parameter.Description: Select the active-map raster layer used for post-event embedding generation when Post-Event Imagery Source is Input Imagery.

Parameter.Name: Post-Event World Imagery Wayback Release
Parameter.Description: Select the World Imagery Wayback release used as the post-event imagery source.

Parameter.Name: Example Points for Similarity Search (Minimum 6)
Parameter.Description: Provide at least six representative example points. Each point must intersect a unique embedding cell; the selected cells define the imagery appearance used by the similarity search.

Parameter.Name: ArcGIS Online Embedding Model
Parameter.Description: Select the ArcGIS Online embedding model to download and use when a custom embedding model is not provided.

Parameter.Name: Custom Embedding Model (.dlpk, Optional Override)
Parameter.Description: Optional local embedding model package that overrides the ArcGIS Online Embedding Model selection.

Parameter.Name: GPU ID
Parameter.Description: Identifier of the GPU used by SAM3 and embedding generation. The default is GPU 0.

Parameter.Name: Batch Size
Parameter.Description: Number of imagery tiles processed per deep-learning batch. Larger values may improve throughput but require more GPU memory.

Parameter.Name: Embedding Grid Size (Optional; Blank = Auto)
Parameter.Description: Spacing factor for embedding generation. Leave blank to use the feature-type recommendation, or provide a positive integer to override it. Smaller grids provide finer spatial detail and increase processing time.

Parameter.Name: Similarity Threshold
Parameter.Description: Minimum embedding-similarity score from greater than 0 through 1. Higher values retain only imagery cells more similar to the example points.

Parameter.Name: Output Features
Parameter.Description: Required output feature class for extracted features, debris coverage polygons, similar embedding cells, or classified target features. Store the output in a file or enterprise geodatabase.

Parameter.Name: Moderate Damage Minimum Coverage (%)
Parameter.Description: Minimum percentage of a target feature covered by similar embedding cells for the Moderate Damage Evidence class. Used only by Damage Assessment.

Parameter.Name: High Damage Minimum Coverage (%)
Parameter.Description: Minimum percentage of a target feature covered by similar embedding cells for the High Damage Evidence class. Used only by Damage Assessment and must exceed the Moderate threshold.

Parameter.Name: Target Features Used
Parameter.Description: Derived output containing the supplied or extracted target features used by the tool.

Parameter.Name: Post-Event Embeddings
Parameter.Description: Derived output containing polygon embedding cells and BLOB embedding values generated from post-event imagery, or the selected existing embeddings.

Parameter.Name: Similar Embedding Features
Parameter.Description: Derived output containing post-event embedding cells that meet the similarity threshold for the selected example points.

Parameter.Name: Keep Intermediate Data
Parameter.Description: Keep generated target features, post-event embeddings, and similar embedding features after successful processing. Clear this option to delete generated intermediate datasets.

Parameter.Name: Existing Post-Event Embeddings (Optional; Skips Generation)
Parameter.Description: Optional existing embedding feature class with a BLOB embedding field. When supplied, post-event imagery preparation and embedding generation are skipped.
